analysis: The only change to docs/architecture/inference.md is documentation: the 'Last updated' date at line 3 is bumped, and a new troubleshooting table row near head line 2555 describes load refusal while an add-on hold is active (TB-012, A-018, T-059). Prefix-cache statements (SSD checkpoints encrypted under the provider cache root, scope-partitioned, TTL-bounded) are consistent with T-041 and are unchanged. No code, configuration, endpoint or authorization behavior changes in this PR as supplied. Remaining limits: the patch excerpt for the new add-on-hold row is truncated, so I could not verify its full wording. The row references docs/architecture/addon-hold.md, and the implementation of the hold (signature check, leases, machine-lock fallback, and the load-gate interaction described in T-059) is outside the supplied evidence. Integration should check that the row's claims match the TB-012/T-059 definitions and that any corresponding code changes elsewhere in the PR keep the load-gate behavior fail-safe. This is a documentation-only change in the units I saw, and I found no regression.
